blocks.zh: IT基礎架構的品質管理系統  |  Pages 18–20
blocks.en: Quality Management System for IT Infrastructure  |  Pages 18–20

blocks.zh: Chapter Introduction  |  章節導言
blocks.en: Chapter Introduction

blocks.zh: 本章描述品質管理系統（QMS）如何協助提供IT基礎架構處於受控狀態的證據，以及QMS達成此目標的關鍵要求。
blocks.en: This chapter describes how a Quality Management System (QMS) helps provide evidence that the IT infrastructure is in a state of control, and the key requirements a QMS must meet to achieve this.

blocks.zh: Why IT Needs Its Own QMS | 為何IT需要自己的QMS
blocks.en: Why IT Needs Its Own QMS

blocks.zh: 傳統製藥QMS涵蓋生產流程。由於IT基礎架構直接支撐GxP電腦化系統（而這些系統管理關鍵產品品質數據），IT部門必須在自身結構化品質框架內運作。
blocks.en: A traditional pharmaceutical QMS covers the manufacturing processes. Because IT infrastructure directly supports the GxP computerized systems that manage critical product quality data, the IT department must operate within its own structured quality framework.

blocks.zh: CDMO IT-QA Governance Model  |  CDMO IT-QA治理模型
blocks.en: CDMO IT-QA Governance Model

blocks.zh: The "Factory Floor" Analogy | 「工廠地板」比喻
blocks.en: The "Factory Floor" Analogy

blocks.zh: 將IT基礎架構想象為所有GxP系統運行的工廠地板。正如實體生產設施需要環境監測、清潔確效和維護SOP，IT「地板」也需要自己的QMS來展示受控狀態。
blocks.en: Think of the IT infrastructure as the factory floor on which every GxP system runs. Just as a physical manufacturing facility needs environmental monitoring, cleaning validation and maintenance SOPs, the IT "floor" needs its own QMS to demonstrate a state of control.

blocks.zh: 3.1 Quality Manual  |  品質手冊
blocks.en: 3.1 Quality Manual

blocks.zh: 品質手冊應根據企業品質政策設定品質目標。頂層文件應涵蓋關鍵IT流程識別、適用程序與標準、以及需維護的記錄與文件。品質手冊應由QA批准。
blocks.en: The quality manual should set quality objectives based on the corporate quality policy. This top-level document should cover the identification of key IT processes, the applicable procedures and standards, and the records and documents to be maintained. The quality manual should be approved by QA.

blocks.zh: QMS Elements for IT Departments  |  IT部門QMS要素
blocks.en: QMS Elements for IT Departments

blocks.zh: 3.2–3.4 Roles, Records & Documentation  |  角色、記錄與文件
blocks.en: 3.2–3.4 Roles, Records & Documentation

blocks.zh: 3.2 角色與職責應明確定義並反映於職務說明。3.3 記錄管理控制確保可檢索性、儲存與保護。3.4 文件管理須可供法規查核，並保持全組織一致性。
blocks.en: 3.2 Roles and responsibilities should be clearly defined and reflected in job descriptions. 3.3 Records management controls should ensure retrievability, storage and protection. 3.4 Document management must be available for regulatory inspection and consistent across the organization.

blocks.zh: CDMO Practical Notes  |  CDMO實務要點
blocks.en: CDMO Practical Notes

blocks.zh: FDA 483常見缺失：IT人員執行影響GxP的任務（如使用者存取管理、備份驗證）卻無文件化的職責指定或培訓記錄。
blocks.en: Common FDA 483 observation: IT staff perform tasks that affect GxP (such as user access management or backup verification) without documented assignment of responsibilities or training records.

blocks.zh: Documentation Readiness for Inspections | 查核文件整備
blocks.en: Documentation Readiness for Inspections

blocks.zh: Analogy: The "Passport Control" Model | 「護照管制」比喻
blocks.en: Analogy: The "Passport Control" Model

blocks.zh: 3.5 Testing Requirements  |  測試要求
blocks.en: 3.5 Testing Requirements

blocks.zh: 測試文件須可追溯至規格、經QA審查核准、具客觀可驗證的接受標準，並記錄實際觀察結果而非僅標示通過/失敗。
blocks.en: Test documentation must be traceable to specifications, reviewed and approved by QA, and have objectively verifiable acceptance criteria. It must record the actual observed results rather than simply marking pass/fail.

blocks.zh: Testing Rigor vs. Risk Level  |  測試嚴格程度與風險等級
blocks.en: Testing Rigor vs. Risk Level

blocks.zh: Risk-Based Testing Principle | 基於風險的測試原則
blocks.en: Risk-Based Testing Principle

blocks.zh: 並非所有IT元件都需要相同程度的測試文件嚴格性。ISPE明確指出嚴格程度與衝擊和風險成正比。
blocks.en: Not all IT components require the same level of rigor in test documentation. ISPE explicitly states that the level of rigor should be proportionate to impact and risk.

blocks.zh: GAMP Comparison | 與GAMP對比
blocks.en: GAMP Comparison

blocks.zh: 3.6–3.9: SOPs, Training, Periodic Review & QA Audit  |  SOP、培訓、定期審查與QA稽核
blocks.en: 3.6–3.9: SOPs, Training, Periodic Review & QA Audit

blocks.zh: 3.6 SOP描述關鍵IT流程。3.7 培訓需規劃並記錄，含外包商。3.8 定期審查維持確效狀態，頻率基於風險。3.9 QA稽核須獨立進行。
blocks.en: 3.6 SOPs describe the key IT processes. 3.7 Training must be planned and documented, including for contractors. 3.8 Periodic review maintains the qualified state, with frequency based on risk. 3.9 QA audits must be conducted independently.

blocks.zh:

blocks.en: During a regulatory inspection, an investigator asks to see all test records for the server hosting the batch record system. The IT manager cannot locate the qualification records from 3 years ago. Which ISPE sections have been violated, and what controls should have been in place?

blocks.en: Your IT contractor recently patched the operating system on a GxP server but there is no training record showing the contractor understood the GxP implications of the patch. Which section addresses this gap, and what should a compliant process look like?

blocks.zh: 將風險管理應用於IT基礎架構  |  Pages 21–23
blocks.en: Applying Risk Management to IT Infrastructure  |  Pages 21–23

blocks.zh: 風險管理由ISO定義為系統性地應用管理政策、程序和實踐，以分析、評估和控制風險。
blocks.en: Risk management is defined by ISO as the systematic application of management policies, procedures and practices to the tasks of analyzing, evaluating and controlling risk.

blocks.zh: 風險評估應在識別為對公司業務重要的物件（如平台、數據）的每個主要生命週期階段執行。
blocks.en: Risk assessment should be performed at each major life cycle phase for objects identified as important to the company's business (such as platforms and data).

blocks.zh: 5 Key Risk Management Activities | 5個關鍵風險管理活動
blocks.en: 5 Key Risk Management Activities

blocks.zh: 公司也可將此風險管理方法應用於不支援GxP應用程式但具業務關鍵性的IT基礎架構元件。
blocks.en: Companies may also apply this risk management approach to IT infrastructure components that do not support GxP applications but are business critical.

blocks.zh: Risk-Based Qualification Scope Decision Matrix  |  基於風險的確效範疇決策矩陣
blocks.en: Risk-Based Qualification Scope Decision Matrix

blocks.zh: Key Principle | 關鍵原則
blocks.en: Key Principle

blocks.zh: 基礎架構人員不應被期望獨立評估GxP合規性。應用/數據擁有者和QA定義哪些平台元件需要確效。
blocks.en: Infrastructure staff should not be expected to assess GxP compliance on their own. The application/data owner and QA define which platform components require qualification.

blocks.zh: 4.1 Identification and Assessment of Components  |  元件識別與評估
blocks.en: 4.1 Identification and Assessment of Components

blocks.zh: 風險分析過程應識別危害和漏洞，評估記錄完整性、可用性、服務可用性、流程有效性及人員可用性的風險。
blocks.en: The risk analysis process should identify hazards and vulnerabilities and assess risks to record integrity, availability, service availability, process effectiveness and personnel availability.

blocks.zh: IT Component Risk Classification Table  |  IT元件風險分類表
blocks.en: IT Component Risk Classification Table

blocks.zh: The "CIA Triad" in GxP Context | GxP脈絡中的「CIA三元組」
blocks.en: The "CIA Triad" in a GxP Context

blocks.zh: 4.2–4.4: Controls, Change Assessment & Periodic Review  |  控制措施、變更評估與定期審查
blocks.en: 4.2–4.4: Controls, Change Assessment & Periodic Review

blocks.zh: 4.2 控制措施包括測試、重新設計、自動監測工具、政策更新等。4.3 變更需評估對確效元件的影響。4.4 定期審查驗證現有控制是否仍然有效。
blocks.en: 4.2 Controls include testing, redesign, automated monitoring tools, policy updates and so on. 4.3 Changes must be assessed for their impact on qualified components. 4.4 Periodic review verifies that existing controls remain effective.

blocks.zh: Risk Control Implementation & GAMP 5 Comparison  |  風險控制實施與GAMP 5對比
blocks.en: Risk Control Implementation & GAMP 5 Comparison

blocks.zh: Change Control — The Critical Link | 變更控制的關鍵連結
blocks.en: Change Control — The Critical Link

blocks.zh: 對確效IT元件的每次變更都必須進行風險評估，防止確效成為一次性事件。
blocks.en: Every change to a qualified IT component must undergo risk assessment, which prevents qualification from becoming a one-time event.

blocks.en: A non-GxP ERP system is installed on the same physical server cluster as the GxP LIMS. How should this situation be handled in the IT risk assessment, and what controls might be required?

blocks.zh:

您已確效的網路交換機正在被不同供應商的新型號替換。ISPE要求的流程是什麼？必須產生哪些文件？
blocks.en: Your qualified network switches are being replaced with a new model from a different vendor. What is the ISPE-required process for this change, and what documentation must be produced?

blocks.zh:
During a periodic review of the IT infrastructure, you discover that a monitoring alert for disk space was disabled 8 months ago and never re-enabled. Walk through the risk management steps you would take, referencing specific ISPE sections.
在IT基礎架構定期審查期間，您發現磁碟空間監測警報在8個月前被停用且從未重新啟用。請引用具體ISPE條款，說明您將採取的風險管理步驟。
blocks.en: During a periodic review of the IT infrastructure, you discover that a monitoring alert for disk space was disabled 8 months ago and never re-enabled. Walk through the risk management steps you would take, referencing specific ISPE sections.

blocks.zh: 平台確效 — 流程概述  |  Pages 24–25
blocks.en: Platform Qualification — Process Overview  |  Pages 24–25

blocks.zh: Overview  |  概述
blocks.en: Overview

blocks.zh: 本節描述如何使用計畫性確效流程，將平台或對現有平台的重大新增項目帶入符合公司既定標準的狀態。輕微新增通常通過變更控制管理。
blocks.en: This section describes how a planned qualification process is used to bring a platform, or a significant new addition to an existing platform, to a state that meets the company's established standards. Minor additions are normally managed through change control.

blocks.zh: Strategy 1: Building-Block (Generic Platform) | 策略1：積木式
blocks.en: Strategy 1: Building-Block (Generic Platform)

blocks.zh: 適用於標準化IT環境，平台規格獨立於具體應用程式，確效平台視為商品。
blocks.en: Applies to standardized IT environments where the platform specification is independent of any specific application and the qualified platform is treated as a commodity.

blocks.zh: Strategy 2: Case-by-Case | 策略2：逐案式
blocks.en: Strategy 2: Case-by-Case

blocks.zh: 適用於高度客製化或特殊應用環境，需與應用程式擁有者密切協作。
blocks.en: Applies to highly customized or specialized application environments that require close collaboration with the application owner.

blocks.zh: Qualification Process Flow & Building-Block Strategy  |  確效流程與積木式策略
blocks.en: Qualification Process Flow & Building-Block Strategy

blocks.zh: Sequential Qualification Steps | 確效步驟順序
blocks.en: Sequential Qualification Steps

blocks.zh: The Building-Block Advantage | 積木式策略的優勢
blocks.en: The Building-Block Advantage

blocks.zh: 對積木類型確效後，各實例可使用縮短確效，降低工作量並加快部署速度。
blocks.en: Once a building-block type has been qualified, each instance can use a reduced qualification, which lowers effort and speeds up deployment.

blocks.en: This life cycle model outlines one way to manage a complex IT infrastructure project. The phases are not strictly sequential; overlap and iteration are common.

blocks.en: Unlike the waterfall model, ISPE explicitly acknowledges that the phases overlap and iterate, in particular that risk assessment continues throughout the planning and specification phases.

A colleague argues that once OQ is complete, the qualification work is done. How would you use the IT Infrastructure lifecycle model to explain why this is incorrect?

blocks.en: A colleague argues that once OQ is complete, the qualification work is done. How would you use the IT Infrastructure lifecycle model to explain why this is incorrect?

During the Retirement phase of an old server, what are the three key deliverables that must be produced, and why are they important from a GxP compliance perspective?
在舊伺服器的退役階段，必須產生哪三個關鍵交付成果？從GxP合規角度，這些為何重要？
blocks.en: During the Retirement phase of an old server, what are the three key deliverables that must be produced, and why are they important from a GxP compliance perspective?

blocks.zh: 規劃 — 平台確效計畫  |  Pages 27–28
blocks.en: Planning — Platform Qualification Plan  |  Pages 27–28

blocks.zh: 5.3.1 Platform Qualification Plan  |  平台確效計畫
blocks.en: 5.3.1 Platform Qualification Plan

blocks.zh: 平台確效計畫應由QA批准，涵蓋職責、生命週期活動、交付成果、時程、審查批准、限制條件、平台元件概覽、關鍵記錄、培訓要求和初步風險評估。
blocks.en: The Platform Qualification Plan should be approved by QA and cover responsibilities, life cycle activities, deliverables, timeline, review and approval, constraints, an overview of platform components, key records, training requirements and a preliminary risk assessment.

blocks.zh: Qualification Planning Deliverables Table  |  確效規劃交付成果表
blocks.en: Qualification Planning Deliverables Table

blocks.zh: Platform vs. Application Qualification: Separation of Concerns | 平台與應用程式確效的分離
blocks.en: Platform vs. Application Qualification: Separation of Concerns

blocks.zh: 平台確效計畫與應用確效計畫的明確分離使「水平」（基於平台）確效成為可能，多個GxP應用程式可利用預先確效的平台，大幅減少總體確效工作量。
blocks.en: Keeping the Platform Qualification Plan clearly separate from the application qualification plan makes "horizontal" (platform-based) qualification possible: multiple GxP applications can leverage a pre-qualified platform, greatly reducing the overall qualification effort.

blocks.zh: Timeline Interdependency Example | 時程相依性範例
blocks.en: Timeline Interdependency Example

blocks.zh:
Your CDMO is upgrading the LIMS application software. The LIMS vendor specifies a new minimum server OS version. What is the correct sequence of qualification activities, and which qualification plan documents would need to be updated or newly created?
您的CDMO正在升級LIMS應用程式。LIMS供應商指定了新的最低伺服器OS版本。確效活動的正確順序是什麼？哪些確效計畫文件需要更新或新建？
blocks.en: Your CDMO is upgrading the LIMS application software. The LIMS vendor specifies a new minimum server OS version. What is the correct sequence of qualification activities, and which qualification plan documents would need to be updated or newly created?

blocks.zh:
Explain how the building-block concept in Platform Qualification Planning creates a "horizontal qualification" benefit across multiple GxP applications, and give a concrete example.
解釋平台確效計畫中的積木式概念如何為多個GxP應用程式創造「水平確效」優勢，並舉一個具體例子。
blocks.en: Explain how the building-block concept in Platform Qualification Planning creates a "horizontal qualification" benefit across multiple GxP applications, and give a concrete example.

blocks.zh:
During the preparation of a Platform Qualification Plan, what level of Risk Assessment is required, and what is the key input from the application/data owner?
在準備平台確效計畫期間，需要什麼層次的風險評估？應用程式/數據擁有者的關鍵輸入是什麼？
blocks.en: During the preparation of a Platform Qualification Plan, what level of Risk Assessment is required, and what is the key input from the application/data owner?

blocks.en: Legacy Platform Considerations  |  Pages 28–30

blocks.zh: Legacy Platform Definition & Approach  |  舊有平台定義與方法
blocks.en: Legacy Platform Definition & Approach

blocks.zh: Experience Report | 經驗報告
blocks.en: Experience Report

blocks.zh: 對於運行令人滿意的舊有平台，密集測試可能影響持續運行，因此可考慮製作「經驗報告」作為進一步規劃的基礎。
blocks.en: For legacy platforms that are operating satisfactorily, intensive testing could disrupt ongoing operation, so an "Experience Report" may be considered as the basis for further planning.

blocks.zh: 5.3.2.1 Determining Extent of Qualification  |  確定確效範圍
blocks.en: 5.3.2.1 Determining Extent of Qualification

blocks.zh: Legacy Qualification Strategy & Testing Priorities  |  舊有平台確效策略與測試優先順序
blocks.en: Legacy Qualification Strategy & Testing Priorities

blocks.zh: 5.3.2.2 Existing Documentation | 現有文件最大化利用
blocks.en: 5.3.2.2 Existing Documentation

blocks.zh: 應最大化利用現有文件以縮短時程和減少返工。重點應放在文件內容的存在性和準確性，而非格式。
blocks.en: Existing documentation should be used as fully as possible to shorten timelines and reduce rework. The focus should be on the existence and accuracy of the document content, not on its format.

blocks.zh: CDMO Real-World Context | CDMO真實情境
blocks.en: CDMO Real-World Context

blocks.zh: 大多數繼承IT基礎架構的CDMO面臨此情境。常見方法：生成經驗報告→差距分析→風險評估確定優先順序→先聚焦存取控制、備份和數據完整性。
blocks.en: Most CDMOs that inherit IT infrastructure face this situation. A common approach: generate an Experience Report, perform a gap analysis, use risk assessment to prioritize, and focus first on access control, backup and data integrity.

blocks.en: Critical Warning on Re-Installation

blocks.zh: Legacy Platform Qualification Planning Checklist  |  舊有平台確效規劃清單
blocks.en: Legacy Platform Qualification Planning Checklist

blocks.zh: Audit legacy IT infrastructure against company procedures and regulatory expectations 審查舊有IT基礎架構
blocks.en: Audit legacy IT infrastructure against company procedures and regulatory expectations

blocks.zh: Identify and document all gaps 識別並記錄所有差距
blocks.en: Identify and document all gaps

blocks.zh: Perform Risk Assessment to justify qualification priorities 執行風險評估以確定確效優先順序
blocks.en: Perform Risk Assessment to justify qualification priorities

blocks.zh: Produce Experience Report for satisfactorily operating systems 為運行良好的系統製作經驗報告
blocks.en: Produce Experience Report for satisfactorily operating systems

blocks.zh: Identify existing documentation reusable for qualification 識別可重用的現有文件
blocks.en: Identify existing documentation reusable for qualification

blocks.zh: Review application validation packages for platform info 審查應用程式確效文件包中的平台資訊
blocks.en: Review application validation packages for platform info

blocks.zh: Develop remediation plan with budget and resource allocation 制定含預算和資源的補救計畫
blocks.en: Develop remediation plan with budget and resource allocation

blocks.zh: Prioritize IQ/OQ based on Risk Assessment outcomes 依風險評估結果排定IQ/OQ優先順序
blocks.en: Prioritize IQ/OQ based on Risk Assessment outcomes

blocks.zh: Confirm network diagrams and component inventory current 確認網路圖和元件清單為最新
blocks.en: Confirm network diagrams and component inventory current

blocks.zh: Assess access control and security posture 評估存取控制和安全態勢
blocks.en: Assess access control and security posture

blocks.zh: Verify backup and disaster recovery procedures 驗證備份和災難復原程序
blocks.en: Verify backup and disaster recovery procedures

blocks.zh: Establish configuration management and change control 建立組態管理和變更控制
blocks.en: Establish configuration management and change control

blocks.zh:
Your CDMO has acquired a manufacturing site that has been operating for 12 years with no formal IT qualification. The site runs a legacy LIMS and MES on servers with no IQ/OQ documentation. Describe your step-by-step approach to qualify this legacy environment, citing ISPE sections and the role of the Experience Report.
您的CDMO收購了一個運營12年但無正式IT確效的製造場址。該場址在沒有IQ/OQ文件的伺服器上運行舊有LIMS和MES。請描述確效此舊有環境的逐步方法，引用ISPE條款並說明經驗報告的作用。
blocks.en: Your CDMO has acquired a manufacturing site that has been operating for 12 years with no formal IT qualification. The site runs a legacy LIMS and MES on servers with no IQ/OQ documentation. Describe your step-by-step approach to qualify this legacy environment, citing ISPE sections and the role of the Experience Report.

blocks.zh:
During legacy qualification planning, a team member proposes re-installing the operating system on all GxP servers to generate clean IQ documentation. What is the ISPE position on this, and what alternative approach would you recommend?
在舊有確效規劃期間，團隊成員建議重新安裝所有GxP伺服器的作業系統以生成清晰的IQ文件。ISPE對此的立場是什麼？您會推薦什麼替代方法？
blocks.en: During legacy qualification planning, a team member proposes re-installing the operating system on all GxP servers to generate clean IQ documentation. What is the ISPE position on this, and what alternative approach would you recommend?

blocks.zh:
A legacy network has no current network diagram and the component inventory hasn't been updated in 3 years. Under which of the three legacy qualification driver categories does this fall, and what should be the immediate remediation steps?
舊有網路沒有最新的網路圖，元件清單3年未更新。這屬於哪個舊有確效驅動因素類別？應採取哪些立即補救步驟？
blocks.en: A legacy network has no current network diagram and the component inventory hasn't been updated in 3 years. Under which of the three legacy qualification driver categories does this fall, and what should be the immediate remediation steps?
